tools.name: list_converters
tools.description: Search the live PNG.now converter catalog and return valid converter slugs such as png-to-jpg, png-to-webp, png-to-pdf, and compress-png.

tools.name: convert_image_url
tools.description: Download a publicly accessible PNG or supported image URL, submit it to PNG.now using a converter slug, and optionally wait for the result. Private-network URLs and embedded URL credentials are rejected.

tools.name: get_conversion_status
tools.description: Check a PNG.now conversion job. A completed job includes an absolute, temporary download URL.

tools.name: get_api_usage
tools.description: Return the caller's PNG.now API credits, usage, and rate limit.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "convert_image_url" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Download a publicly accessible PNG or supported image URL, submit it to PNG.now using a converter slug, and optionally wait for the result. Private-network URLs…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_conversion_status · Private data: convert_image_url · Public sink: convert_image_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_conversion_status · Private data: convert_image_url · Public sink: convert_image_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
